items.gem-red-hand-render.note: CONFIRMED BROKEN: corpus:gem_red renders as missing-texture (magenta/black checkerboard) in the hotbar and as a giant missing-model black/magenta shape in first person. The pack-defined display name 'Red Gem' DOES reach the client, so item metadata + give logic work — the failure is resource-pack-level. ROOT CAUSE (client log): 'Caught error loading resourcepacks, removing all selected resourcepacks' after 'Couldn't compile vertex shader (minecraft:core/rendertype_text): ERROR: 6:21: assign : l-value required Position (cannot modify an attribute)'. The delivered pack's materione_26_1 overlay overrides assets/minecraft/shaders/core/rendertype_text.vsh with a generated hook (materionePreTransform) whose text-effect wobble does 'Position.y += sin(...)' — a direct assignment to the 'in vec3 Position' ATTRIBUTE, which GLSL forbids. 26.1.2's text/gui_text/text_polygon_offset pipelines all reference this vertex shader, so one bad compile fails ALL required shader programs and the client drops the ENTIRE pack (vanilla fallback) — every custom asset then renders checkerboarded. The 1_21_4/1_21_6/26_2 overlays should be audited for the same attribute-mutation pattern. Fix direction: copy Position into a local (vec3 mtrPosition), mutate the local in the hook, and use it for gl_Position in the generated vsh template.
